name: Add a TODO refinement Stage Prompt
description:
Factory review recommendation 16 of 20.

## Context

Scope questions raised during implementation could be surfaced earlier by a readiness pass.

## Acceptance criteria

- Enable a TODO Stage Prompt that reviews Story readiness and records concrete questions or missing requirements in a Comment.
- Keep the Story in its current Stage and avoid authorizing implementation.
- Ensure a completed readiness pass does not trigger repeated identical runs without new input.

Recheck the reviewed behavior against the current implementation and configuration before making changes. Update the relevant documentation, skill guidance and repository configuration together where applicable.

comments.author: sunny
comments.body: PLAN NEEDS SMALL REVISION before implementation acceptance. Advisory TODO once per visit, no move/implementation, no Done-loop, no ADR are approved direction. A Reviewed input line with counts/latest Comment alone cannot detect edited Spec/Task/link/Epic/older Comment/blocker/prompt changes. Propose a stable complete-input fingerprint (or equivalent complete comparison) covering actual review inputs, excluding readiness-generated output; compare only equal complete known inputs and ask/report gaps rather than claiming no new input on an incomplete fingerprint. Include Epic and blocker status among inputs. Keep all .rowbly proposals outside Data Root for supervisor review/application after validation; do not enable TODO yourself. You may own one sentence in factory loop step4, separate from ROW-47/48/57 sections. Update user-guide if documenting human-facing run-clear readiness workflow. Screenshots on temporary Data Root as proposed are appropriate. Send revised prompt/fingerprint method before coding.

comments.author: sunny
comments.body: Revised direction is good, but fingerprint script is NOT accepted yet. Please fix fail-closed reads before implementation: missing jq/sha256sum/plugins-list, failed specs list/show, blocker reads and pipeline stages must yield a gap with no overall (current no pipefail and grouped commands can mask failures as empty JSON). Check every subcommand exit, do not infer Plugin off from unreadable list, and validate expected JSON types. Read guide only as own regular non-symlink file; distinguish absent from unreadable/unsafe rather than omit it. Align claimed off-Plugin behavior with story bag contents. Add throwaway fault scenarios for each read class, not just happy-path input changes, and include actual full script in proposed prompt, no placeholder. jq and sha256sum verified /usr/bin on rook. Keep .rowbly proposals outside Data Root; no actual enable yet. No repository edits until revised acceptance. Use dedicated script/reference instead of embedding large shell in prompt if simpler, but maintain self-contained published skill. Method/version explicit. No need ask user for these routine correctness fixes.
